# Gideon Amowogbaje

> Fullstack developer with 8+ years of experience (Laravel, Go, Node.js/NestJS, React/Next.js) specializing in API & CRM integrations, e-commerce/WooCommerce, AI-powered automation, admin panels and full-stack SaaS builds. Based in Nigeria and available for remote roles and freelance work.

## Live projects
- [Qset](https://qset.amowogbaje.com): exam builder for teachers with Word (docx) export.
- [Tax](https://tax.amowogbaje.com): Nigerian personal income tax calculator.
- [Storyverse](https://storyverse.amowogbaje.com): serialized-fiction platform with multi-gateway subscriptions.
- [CraftProfessor Story Engine](https://craftprofessor.amowogbaje.com/): AI content pipeline publishing to Pinterest.
- [Jobs](https://jobs.amowogbaje.com): experimental job board and application tracker.
